summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S., a Turkish telecom listed on Borsa Istanbul and reporting via SEC Form 6-K, filed a press release on October 20, 2026 announcing only the calendar for its third-quarter 2026 financial results. Results for July 1 through September 30, 2026 are scheduled for public release on November 9, 2026, after Borsa Istanbul trading hours. The filing names no terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation; watch the November 9 disclosure for guidance and any capital-allocation commentary.
